_approach: A high/low conga call-and-response loop drives the groove Masters At Work/Nuyorican Soul style, with the kick and clap kept simple underneath and hats pulled right back. MPC swing 60% (engine 0.20) -- deep enough that the congas read as genuinely played rather than gridded. Reference: Nuyorican Soul, Kerri Chandler 'Bar A Thym'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
